purpose: Validate automatic muzzle placement and coherent effects on the pack's largest weapon silhouette.

style.perspective: strict side view, effect travels or emits toward the right

frames.prompt: Create one original isolated pixel-art Ion Cannon projectile sprite, strict side view travelling right. Draw a heavy elongated pale-blue ion core wrapped by a broad cyan electrical field, with a restrained violet wake and several short energy filaments, readable at 64x32 pixels. Use crisp hard pixel clusters, no gradients, no antialiasing, no weapon, no character, no text, no shadow, no floor, no border, and no other objects. Center the projectile. Use only dark gunmetal, cyan, violet, pale blue, and white. The entire background, including every enclosed empty area, must be a perfectly flat solid pure green #00ff00 chroma field.

Create the peak keyframe of one original isolated pixel-art Ion Cannon muzzle discharge, strict side view emitting only toward the right. Draw a large horizontal cyan-white electrical lance that begins at one narrow attachment point on the exact left-center edge and expands rightward into a powerful tapered wedge with restrained violet branches. The silhouette must be wider than it is tall. Do not draw a circular explosion, ring, orb, projectile, weapon, character, text, shadow, floor, border, or other object. Use crisp hard pixel clusters, no gradients and no antialiasing. Keep it fully inside the canvas. The entire background and every enclosed empty area must be perfectly flat solid pure green #00ff00.

Create the peak keyframe of one original isolated stationary pixel-art Ion Cannon impact. Draw one large centered cyan-white electrical detonation with a thick pale-blue energy ring, restrained violet arcs, and several short radial sparks. It must be symmetrical enough to scale around the exact canvas center and must not imply travel on x or y. Do not draw a projectile, weapon, character, surface, text, shadow, floor, border, or other object. Use crisp hard pixel clusters, no gradients and no antialiasing. Keep it fully inside the canvas. The entire background and every enclosed empty area must be perfectly flat solid pure green #00ff00.
